steps.name: grep-guard (no ambient time/randomness in the kernel; PLATFORM-noted in adapters)
steps.run:
if git grep -nE 'Date\.now\(|Math\.random\(|setTimeout\(|setInterval\(|performance\.now\(' -- packages/cache/src ':(exclude)packages/cache/src/adapters'; then
  echo "::error::ambient time/randomness found in kernel (non-adapter) src"
  exit 1
fi
fail=0
for f in $(git ls-files 'packages/cache/src/adapters/**/*.ts'); do
  awk '
    /PLATFORM:/ { last=NR }
    /Date\.now\(|Math\.random\(|setTimeout\(|setInterval\(|performance\.now\(/ {
      if (last == 0 || NR - last > 3) { printf "%s:%d: ambient platform call without a nearby // PLATFORM: note\n", FILENAME, NR; bad=1 }
    }
    END { exit bad }
  ' "$f" || fail=1
done
if [ "$fail" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "::error::an adapter ambient-time use lacks a // PLATFORM: justification (ground rule 5)"
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: grep-guard (no quoted design prose in tracked comments)
steps.run:
fail=0
if git grep -niE '^[[:space:]]*(//|\*).*(the errata|errata.?s|the spec|the design).*"' -- ':!*.json'; then
  echo "::error::a comment attributes to the design docs next to a quote — paraphrase it (numbers-only cites only)"
  fail=1
fi
if git grep -nE '^[[:space:]]*(//|\*)[^"]*"[^"]*$' -- ':!*.json' | grep -vE '"[^"]*"'; then
  echo "::error::a comment opens a multi-line quoted span — likely copied design prose"
  fail=1
fi
exit "$fail"

steps.name: binary tripwire (no NUL byte in any tracked file)
snapshot integrity (comments-only migration)
resolved Vitest cohort (direct and Vite+ share one instance)
invariants (sacred suite)
append pass/fail count to the job summary
prove the lint autofixer runs, then require it left sacred untouched
steps.run:
probe=packages/cache/test/unit/__autofix_liveness_probe.test.ts
trap 'rm -f "$probe"' EXIT
printf 'import { expect, it } from "vitest";\nit("autofix liveness probe", () => {\n  expect(1).toStrictEqual(1);\n});\n' > "$probe"
pnpm fix || true
if ! grep -q 'toBe(1)' "$probe"; then
  echo "::error::the lint autofixer did not rewrite the seeded probe (toStrictEqual→toBe) — the assertion-rewriting pass did not run, so the sacred check below would pass vacuously. Fix the fixer invocation before trusting this gate."
  exit 1
fi
if ! git diff --exit-code -- packages/cache/test/invariants packages/cache/test/scenarios; then
  echo "::error::an autofix rewrote a sacred test. Sacred is append-only for tools too: a fixer's diff here is an unauthorized amendment. Repeal the offending rule if it contradicts signed law, or fence it — never accept the rewrite."
  exit 1
fi
echo "lint autofixer proven live; sacred lane untouched"

steps.name: demo-boot-witness (the composed demo establishes its bus channel on workerd)
require every CI lane to pass
steps.run:
echo "::notice::integration finished with $(jq -r '.integration.result // "absent"' <<<"$RESULTS") — adjudicate per ground rule 14"
if ! jq -e 'del(.integration) | all(.[]; .result == "success")' <<<"$RESULTS" >/dev/null; then
  jq -r 'del(.integration) | to_entries[] | select(.value.result != "success") | "\(.key) finished with \(.value.result)"' <<<"$RESULTS" |
    while IFS= read -r failure; do
      echo "::error::$failure"
    done
  exit 1
fi
